messages:
morgan: Heads-up — Alex handed in their resignation this morning, last day will be Fri Apr 9. Need to coordinate benefits cutoff, equipment return, and staged access removal. Who can own which items?
shawn: I can own knowledge transfer and oncall handoff. Alex is on the infra team so we'll do a 1-hr doc + walkthru by Wed.
alex: thanks. I'll start a short runbook and share links. happy to do the walkthru Wed afternoon.
ida: Security here — propose staged access removal: disable SSO + prod deploy keys on last day EOD, rotate service account creds 48hrs after last day. Need list of systems Alex uses.
it-ops: IT will schedule a courier if Alex needs to drop off hardware. Please confirm device list. We typically request laptop, dongles, and badge.
payroll-bot: Reminder: final payroll cutoff is Apr 6 for Apr 9 terminations — submit termination form by EOD Tue to avoid delay in last paycheck. COBRA notice will be auto-generated on termination date.
morgan: @it-ops Alex has: 1x M2 laptop, USB-C dock, and badge. Alex — do you also have a company phone?
alex: no company phone. I'll return laptop/dock/badge. Put courier on Thu morning if possible.
shawn: I'll take the termination form and submit payroll by Tue. Alex — can you confirm PTO balance? We need to know proration/paid out amount.
alex: PTO balance shows 24.5 hrs in Workday. OK to payout or use last week, whichever is simpler.
sam-peopleops: I'll own COBRA communications and exit interview scheduling. Alex, what time window for exit interview next week? We usually do 30 min.
ida: Also flagging: analytics read-only access — we can keep that for two weeks post-offboard if manager approves for knowledge transfer. Otherwise remove on last day. @shawn confirm?
shawn: Approve two-week read-only for analytics. No prod deploys after EOD last day.
it-ops: Courier scheduled Thu 9–12 local window. Please pack laptop in box and leave on front desk.
morgan: Summary of owners: IT = hardware pick-up; Payroll = termination form + final pay; Security = staged credential removal; Sam = COBRA & exit interview; Shawn = KT and oncall handoff. I'll create a checklist and ping everyone with deadlines.
alex: Thanks all. I'll post the runbook link and confirm KT time by EOD. Appreciate the smooth handoff. :slightly_smiling_face:
sam-peopleops: Alex, sending exit interview invite for Tue Apr 6 10am. If that doesn't work, reply here and we'll reschedule.
payroll-bot: Termination filed by shawn at 2026-04-01T16:04Z (automated). Final pay processed with PTO payout option selected.
ida: Noted. I'll prepare the access revocation plan and post the exact removal schedule (timestamps + accounts) tomorrow.
morgan: Thanks everyone — I'll update the checklist and close loop once all items are done. :white_check_mark:
